name: RecordShare
description: Generic record-sharing table (plan-52 slice 52-E). Each row grants one user (or group, future) read access to one record of a specific class. Used as the default share table for any class declaring `ownership: "user"` and `shareTable: "RecordShare"`. The framework is generic over the share-table name — a class may declare a different shareTable, but it must have this same column shape. Generic CRUD is blocked; reads and writes go through /api/v2.0/share/* endpoints which run their own authorization (record owner can grant / list grants; owner or grantee can revoke).

attributes.name: className
attributes.description: Class name (PascalCase) of the shared record. Together with sharedRecordId identifies one row in one table.

attributes.name: sharedRecordId
attributes.description: ID of the shared row in the table named by className. Deliberately verbose vs. recordId — disambiguates from this row's own id.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Grantee user. Exactly one of idOfUser / idOfGroup is set per row. V1 supports only user-shares.

attributes.name: idOfGroup
attributes.description: Grantee group (reserved — group-shares not enabled in V1; column present for forward compatibility).

attributes.name: permission
attributes.description: Granted permission level. V1 enforces visibility (read access) only; read-write and admin are stored but not yet honored on writes.

attributes.name: sharedBy
attributes.description: User id that granted this share (audit field — the RecordShare row itself is the audit trail).

attributes.name: expiresAt
attributes.description: Optional epoch-ms timestamp after which this share is no longer effective. Filtered by the ownership predicate (NULL means no expiry).
